documentation_gate: Existing verified FRD 17 plus accepted ADR-0006/PDR-0007 and current contract catalog satisfy preparation authority. Detailed executable contracts and UX/provider/policy evidence are refined in the owning slice before code.

acceptance_coverage.case: candidate email cannot replace before proof
passkey/TOTP enrollment remains inactive until proof
Tunner revocation and Product propagation are separately evidenced
concurrent email/security mutations detect version conflicts
Account activation creates no Product membership/entitlement

work_items.title: Calendar-safe adult eligibility and derived evidence
acceptance_criteria: Evaluate the approved DOB + 18 calendar years <= trusted server evaluation date expression, including exact birthday and leap/calendar boundaries.
Return the AGE_INELIGIBLE outcome for an under-18 applicant; produce policy/version, evaluation date and evidence/correlation references without retaining raw DOB in the result.
Expose an Accounts-owned internal capability with no Account/session/Product Relationship creation or public endpoint in this slice.
required_tests: restricted DOB minimization and explicit policy/evidence provenance
domain dependency direction and platform regression

work_items.title: Account and Identity persistence/framework foundation
acceptance_criteria: Refine and implement Accounts/Identity-owned canonical resources and state versions with ASP.NET Core Identity + OpenIddict at currently researched supported versions.
Preserve stable Tunner-owned identifiers and domain boundaries; framework/provider types are not cross-domain authority.
Rehearse forward/rollback-safe database changes and uniqueness/concurrency behavior; configure explicit operator/policy values without inventing security defaults.
required_tests: real PostgreSQL migration rehearsal and uniqueness/concurrency
primary-source package compatibility and dependency scan

work_items.title: Registration and verified-contact activation vertical slice
acceptance_criteria: Implement registration through server-side eligibility and verification-pending activation without arbitrary Account enumeration.
Require valid proof and atomic uniqueness recheck for activation; duplicate operations are idempotent and post-commit effects remain explicit.
Implement only approved registration/verification UX and governed content; no age-attestation checkbox or Product membership/entitlement creation.
required_tests: BFF/browser accessibility and no enumeration or raw-DOB leakage

work_items.title: Authentication and server-managed BFF sessions
acceptance_criteria: Implement password authentication and sign-out through server-managed Tunner/BFF sessions and versioned policy values.
Rotate identifiers at authentication/material privilege changes, enforce active Account restrictions and expiry, and keep OAuth tokens out of browser JavaScript.
Reuse User/Admin BFF separation and shared error/authorization mechanics.
required_tests: cookie/session boundary and restricted/closed Account rejection
browser token absence and approved login UX

work_items.title: Versioned assurance and operation-bound step-up
acceptance_criteria: Resolve approved assurance requirements at sensitive-operation execution from versioned policy.
Bind fresh step-up proof to the operation/context and policy lifetime; prevent reuse as a general session upgrade.
Do not invent assurance mappings, timeouts or risk thresholds; obtain actual configured policy evidence before enabling affected runtime paths.
required_tests: wrong operation/context, expiry and replay rejection
sensitive action UX and safe error outcomes

work_items.title: Passkey registration authentication and revocation
acceptance_criteria: Implement WebAuthn/passkey ceremonies under approved relying-party/origin and security policy configuration.
Keep credentials inactive until successful ceremony, retain public metadata only, and require authorized step-up for mutations.
Never receive/log passkey private material; use current primary-source standards/framework evidence.

work_items.title: TOTP enrollment verification and disable lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Keep TOTP enrollment inactive until the first valid verification code.
Protect seed material and require approved step-up/policy for enable/disable/reset; do not expose seeds to Admin/Support.
Preserve operation identity and audit evidence without storing secrets in logs/events.
required_tests: first-code activation, wrong-code and replay/rate controls
safe UI, logs and audit evidence

work_items.title: Recovery-code issuance replacement and consumption
acceptance_criteria: Generate/display/download each recovery-code set once and store verifier-safe representations only.
Atomically consume individual codes and invalidate replaced sets according to approved policy.
Require fresh authorized step-up and preserve safe operation/audit lineage.

work_items.title: Google and Microsoft federation and explicit linking
acceptance_criteria: Normalize provider plus immutable subject into Tunner-owned links; never link solely because emails match.
Require existing-Account authentication/recovery for verified-email collision and explicit confirmed link flows.
Prevent unlinking the last policy-required authentication/recovery path; provider email changes do not rewrite identity keys.
required_tests: subject immutability, callback state/replay and explicit linking
provider failure and last-authenticator unlink rejection

work_items.title: Proof-hierarchy Account recovery workflow
acceptance_criteria: Enforce approved strong-authenticator, recovery-code, safe-contact/risk and governed review precedence; Support cannot bypass it.
Make session revocation/authenticator invalidation/MFA reenrollment and restrictions explicit in RecoveryResult under active policy.
Keep recovery idempotent, enumeration-resistant and free of security questions or existing credential disclosure.
required_tests: proof hierarchy and Support bypass rejection
duplicate/concurrent recovery and explicit side effects
safe recovery UI and restricted evidence

work_items.title: Verified-contact change with candidate proof and uniqueness
acceptance_criteria: Keep the existing verified contact effective while an unverified candidate awaits proof.
Require fresh authorized step-up, proof completion and atomic normalized uniqueness/version checks before replacement.
Ordinary profile editing and Product-provided email cannot establish verified Tunner contact evidence.
required_tests: approved contact-change UX and notification/audit lineage

work_items.title: Session device listing trust and revocation
acceptance_criteria: Expose permission-safe Tunner session/device evidence; device trust never substitutes for authentication.
Apply immediate idempotent Tunner revocation and separately evidence Product propagation/acknowledgement where contracted.
Do not claim global Product sign-out without every relevant Product contract and acknowledgement.
required_tests: safe session/device UX and truthful Product propagation states

work_items.title: OpenIddict Product authorization and revocation contracts
acceptance_criteria: Validate registered Product/environment/client/redirect/PKCE, Tunner session and Product Relationship before client/audience/scope-bound OAuth/OIDC issuance.
Keep Tunner Account, Product membership and Product-local sessions distinct; revoke grants/refresh artifacts according to active policy.
Refine detailed contracts against approved Product integration authority and current OpenIddict/standards documentation before runtime integration.
required_tests: contract conformance and provider/protocol failure cases

work_items.title: Account restrictions and closure with owner-domain blockers
acceptance_criteria: Preserve versioned restrictions and canonical ACTIVE/RESTRICTED/CLOSING/CLOSED transitions under approved policy and proof.
Evaluate defined Billing/Finance/Product/Security/Privacy blockers through owner contracts without implementing their domains or treating unknown availability as clearance.
Preserve immutable evidence and disable new authentication for CLOSED Accounts; exceptional erroneous closure correction requires governed Security/Recovery before purge.
required_tests: owner blockers and unavailable/unknown dependency paths
closure-review UX with exact safe owner-resolution paths and retained evidence

work_items.title: Identity post-commit notification and audit integration
acceptance_criteria: Emit approved versioned Identity events only after authoritative commit and reuse P1 outbox/inbox/audit/correlation primitives.
Pass safe stable references to notification delivery contracts with governed content/version provenance; do not duplicate the Notification domain.
Preserve idempotency, retry/failure evidence and sensitive payload minimization.
required_tests: atomic commit/outbox and duplicate consumer handling

work_items.title: P2 end-to-end security privacy and UX conformance
acceptance_criteria: Execute every FRD 17 acceptance case across API/BFF/UI and actual disposable infrastructure with negative, concurrent, replay, recovery and authorization coverage.
Verify approved UX/accessibility, governed content, no Product membership/entitlement mutation and no credential/raw-DOB leakage.
Record actual committed SHAs, dependency/security results, migration evidence and unresolved scoped findings without substituting discovery for execution.
required_tests: fresh context/recovery and required role review evidence

work_items.title: P2 acceptance and integration handoff
acceptance_criteria: Assemble committed P2 evidence, required reviews, known issues and exact implementation/closure lineage.
Obtain actual authorized human Product acceptance before claiming it, and retain protected-main merge/release controls separately.
Run native milestone readiness and lifecycle checks; preserve unrelated work and refresh the final bounded context/handoff.
required_tests: evidence hash/lineage and actual acceptance review

release_boundary: Local validated prerequisites permit P2 work. P1 is historically CLOSED and new remote image/gate findings belong to release-blocking P1-RV001; do not suppress them or infer deployment approval.
